tools.name: get_vocal_profile
tools.description: Turn a singer's vocal range into a normalized HumMatch vocal profile: a persistent Vocal ID, voice type, and tone label. Call this first when you know someone's range and want a profile to reuse across the other HumMatch tools.

rangeLow.description: Lowest comfortable note, as a note name like "D3" or a raw MIDI number.

rangeHigh.description: Highest comfortable note, as a note name like "C5" or a raw MIDI number.

voiceType.description: Optional voice type hint (soprano, mezzo, alto, tenor, baritone, bass). Inferred from the range when omitted.

tools.name: recommend_songs
tools.description: Rank the HumMatch catalog for one singer and return the songs they can actually sing, scored for range fit, karaoke difficulty, and voice-type suitability. Call this when someone asks what they should sing, what suits their voice or range, or wants karaoke song suggestions. Returns a ranked list plus named buckets (safest picks, easy wins, crowd pleasers, songs to avoid).

rangeLow.description: Lowest comfortable note, as a note name like "D3" or a raw MIDI number.

rangeHigh.description: Highest comfortable note, as a note name like "C5" or a raw MIDI number.

voiceType.description: Optional voice type hint (soprano, mezzo, alto, tenor, baritone, bass). Inferred from the range when omitted.

limit.description: How many songs to return per bucket (default 12, max 50).

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Search HumMatch by song title or artist. Use this to resolve a song someone named into the catalog slug that check_song_fit needs, or to look up a song's measured vocal range. Pass rangeLow/rangeHigh as well to score every result against that voice and get the hits ranked by fit.

q.description: Search text: a song title, an artist, or both.

rangeLow.description: Optional. Lowest note of the singer, to score and rank the results by fit.

rangeHigh.description: Optional. Highest note of the singer, to score and rank the results by fit.

tools.name: check_song_fit
tools.description: Score a specific catalog song against a singer's range and explain why it fits or does not, including a suggested key to transpose to. Call this when someone asks whether they can sing a particular song. Resolve the song with search_songs first to get its slug.

slug.description: The catalog slug of the song, from search_songs.

rangeLow.description: Lowest comfortable note, as a note name like "D3" or a raw MIDI number.

rangeHigh.description: Highest comfortable note, as a note name like "C5" or a raw MIDI number.

voiceType.description: Optional voice type hint (soprano, mezzo, alto, tenor, baritone, bass). Inferred from the range when omitted.

tools.name: group_song_fit
tools.description: Given two or more singers' ranges, find the vocal range they share and the songs that sit inside it. Call this for karaoke night with friends, a duet, a choir or worship team, or any "what can we all sing" question.

profiles.description: Two or more singers, each with a rangeLow and rangeHigh.

id.description: Optional label for this singer, e.g. their name.

rangeLow.description: Lowest note, as a note name or MIDI number.

rangeHigh.description: Highest note, as a note name or MIDI number.
